main-title: More control. Fewer cigarettes. Your pace.
main-app-description: QYSH helps you understand, reduce and achieve your goal – with clear statistics, smart timers and seamless device integration.
main-optional-note: QYSH works for any type of smoking – the Bluetooth connection to compatible IQOS devices is entirely optional.
motivation-description: Reducing smoking isn't easy – but it's achievable with the right tool. QYSH offers you clear data, motivating statistics and smart timers so you reach your goal without losing track.
card-countdown-description: See exactly when the next session is, how many you've had today, and what limit applies.
card-statistic-description: Interactive diagrams for day, month, and year – including costs.
card-goals-description: Reduction plan with automatic intervals or fixed daily limits – you set the pace.
card-notifications-description: Notifications at timer end, daily limit, and daily summary.
function-today-description: Today's sessions, daily limit, last session timestamp, and countdown to the next one. Quick entry – even retroactively.
function-statistic-description: Day/Month/Year overview, scrollable charts, cost calculation, and list of today's sessions (incl. deletion).
function-settings-description: Reduction plan, fixed limits with automatic intervals, notifications, design.
function-widgets-description: All widget types, device widget with battery status – information at a glance.
function-watch-description: Countdown, daily limit, last session, entry button, device overview with charging status – right on your wrist.
widgets-title: Always informed – without opening the app
widgets-description: Home Screen and device widgets, and Watch OS/Wear OS widgets keep your progress right at your fingertips.
widget-actual-description: Daily stats & countdown at a glance.
widget-watch-description: Countdown & device charging status right on your wrist.
alt-countdown: Countdown timer showing time until the next session
alt-counter: QYSH countdown screen with today's sessions and daily limit
alt-progress: QYSH statistics screen with interactive charts
alt-goals: QYSH reduction plan and daily limit settings
alt-actual-widget: Today widget with daily stats and countdown
alt-device-widget: Device widget showing IQOS battery level
integrations-description: Monitor and control compatible IQOS devices through QYSH.
integration-notifications: Notifications: not in charger, connection lost, battery low/full
integrations-compatibility: Compatible devices: IQOS ILUMA ONE, IQOS ILUMA, IQOS ILUMA PRIME, IQOS ILUMA i and IQOS ILUMA i PRIME. Available functions may vary depending on the model.
privacy-content: This privacy policy applies to this website as well as to the app QYSH (hereinafter referred to as the app).
privacy-data-content: This app itself collects no personal data beyond what is described in this policy. All data you enter is stored locally on your device.
privacy-minors-content: The app is intended exclusively for adults aged 18 or older, in line with our Terms of Use. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors.
privacy-email-content: If you contact us by email (e.g., for support inquiries), your email address and the data contained in the email will be stored by us in order to process your request.
privacy-email-legal-basis: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (Art. 6 Abs. 1 lit. b DSGVO) or Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (Art. 6 Abs. 1 lit. f DSGVO).
privacy-email-deletion: The data will be deleted as soon as your request has been finally resolved and there are no statutory retention obligations to the contrary.
privacy-domain-hosting-title: Domain Infrastructure and Web Hosting (IONOS & GitHub)
privacy-domain-hosting-content: For the technical operation of this website, we use services for the provision of the domain and web space hosting.
privacy-domain-hosting-domain: Domain & DNS: The domain of this website is registered with IONOS SE. When the domain is accessed, requests are routed through the nameservers of IONOS SE to establish the connection to the website.
privacy-domain-hosting-hosting: Web hosting: The actual content of this website is provided via GitHub Pages by the provider GitHub Inc. When accessing the page, GitHub automatically processes technical data (e.g., IP address, browser type, operating system, time of access) in server logs.
privacy-domain-hosting-legal-basis: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (Art. 6 Abs. 1 lit. f DSGVO).
privacy-domain-hosting-transfer: Third-country transfer: GitHub Inc. is certified under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, which ensures an adequate level of data protection.
privacy-domain-hosting-other: No cookies are set on this website and no external resources are loaded. Only the language you select is stored locally in your browser (localStorage) so that your choice is remembered on your next visit; this information is not transmitted to us and can be deleted at any time by clearing your browser data.
privacy-links-title: Links to App Store / Google Play
privacy-links-content: This website links to the Apple App Store and the Google Play Store. By clicking on these external links, you leave our website. The privacy policies of the respective provider will then apply:
privacy-rights-content: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, and restriction of processing of your personal data, as well as the right to data portability. You also have the right to object, on grounds relating to your particular situation, at any time to the processing of data concerning you which is carried out on the basis of Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (Art. 6 Abs. 1 lit. f DSGVO). Since the app itself does not collect any data, in practice these rights primarily concern data generated by the website infrastructure (server logs) or via email contact. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, in particular the supervisory authority of the German federal state in which you reside. The authority responsible for us is the North Rhine-Westphalia Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information (Landesbeauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit Nordrhein-Westfalen, LDI NRW).
privacy-automated-decisions: We do not use automated decision-making or profiling within the meaning of Art. 22 GDPR (Art. 22 DSGVO).
privacy-update-content: This policy will be updated as soon as the data protection practices of the app or the website change.
privacy-bluetooth-content: If you optionally connect your IQOS device via Bluetooth, we use this interface solely to read device data (e.g., battery status, MAC address).
privacy-bluetooth-data: No Server Transmission: All data is processed exclusively locally on your smartphone. No data is transmitted to our servers or third parties.
privacy-bluetooth-legal-basis: Legal Basis & Revocation: Processing is based on your consent Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR (Art. 6 Abs. 1 lit. a DSGVO) granted via the app permission. You can revoke this permission at any time in your smartphone's system settings.
privacy-storage-duration-content: We follow a strict 'Privacy by Design' approach. Since all your entries and usage data (such as logged smoking sessions including timestamps and costs, personal app settings, and connected devices) are stored exclusively local within the app's secure sandbox database on your own smartphone, we never have access to this data.
privacy-storage-duration-criteria: The data remains on your device for as long as you use the app. You have full control over the retention period: you can delete individual entries or reset settings at any time directly within the app. Uninstalling the app from your smartphone will automatically and permanently delete all locally stored data from your device. No server-side archiving or backup storage is performed by us.
privacy-storage-duration-backup: Please note: if you have enabled your device's operating system backup (e.g., iCloud Backup on iOS or the Google backup on Android) or a device-to-device transfer, your locally stored app data (entries, settings, connected devices) may be included in it so that you can restore your data when changing or resetting your device. These backups are operated by Apple or Google under their own terms and privacy policies; we have no access to them. You can manage or disable device backups at any time in your device's system settings.
privacy-purchases-content: Using the app requires a paid subscription (monthly, annual, or lifetime), purchased directly through the Apple App Store or Google Play. The purchase itself, including your payment and billing details, is processed exclusively by Apple Inc. or Google LLC as independent controllers, in accordance with their own privacy policies. We do not receive, process, or store your payment data.
privacy-purchases-entitlement: To grant you access, the app verifies your subscription or purchase status directly with Apple or Google (via StoreKit / Google Play Billing) on your device. We do not operate a backend server for this purpose, and no purchase-related data is transmitted to or stored by us.
privacy-purchases-legal-basis: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (Art. 6 Abs. 1 lit. b DSGVO), to the extent this constitutes processing of personal data by us at all.
privacy-purchases-transfer: Third-country transfer: Apple Inc. and Google LLC are based in the USA and are certified under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.
privacy-versions-content: On launch, the app retrieves a small version file (versions.json) from our website (qysh.mircov.de) to check whether the Terms of Use or this privacy policy have changed since you last accepted them. The app itself does not transmit any personal data in this process; however, since the website is hosted on GitHub Pages, GitHub Inc. automatically processes technical data (e.g., your IP address) in server logs when this request is made (see the section 'Domain Infrastructure and Web Hosting').
privacy-versions-legal-basis: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (Art. 6 Abs. 1 lit. f DSGVO) – legitimate interest in informing users about changes to the legal documents.
privacy-crash-content: If you have enabled the corresponding option in your device settings (e.g., "Share With App Developers" on iOS or "Usage & diagnostics" on Android), Apple and/or Google may share anonymized crash and performance reports with us to help us identify and fix technical issues. This data is provided to us in anonymized or aggregated form and does not allow us to directly identify you.
privacy-crash-legal-basis: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (Art. 6 Abs. 1 lit. f DSGVO) – legitimate interest in ensuring the stability and quality of the app, to the extent this constitutes processing of personal data at all.
privacy-crash-opt-out: You can disable this sharing at any time in your device's system settings.
download-title: Ready to take the first step?
download-description: Download QYSH and start your personal plan today.
faq-question-plan: How do I set my daily limit or reduction plan?
faq-answer-plan: When you first start the app, you'll be asked whether you want to use a fixed limit or a reduction plan. You can change this anytime in the Countdown settings. There, you define how many sessions per day you want and whether this number should automatically decrease over time.
faq-question-costs: How does the app track my spending?
faq-answer-costs: To calculate your costs, you need to enter the price per pack and quantity per pack in the Statistics settings. Afterward, you'll see your daily, monthly, or yearly spending in the Statistics view.
faq-question-manual-input: How do I select an exact time for a session?
faq-answer-manual-input: Press and hold the '+' button. This opens a menu where you can select an exact time for the session.
faq-question-background: Does the app need to run in the background?
faq-answer-background: Yes, the app should not be fully closed so it can continue communicating with your connected devices in the background.
faq-question-device-widget: What does automatic device selection in the Device Widget mean?
faq-answer-device-widget: If active, the widget always displays the most recently used device.
faq-question-device-battery-low: Should I let my IQOS device discharge completely?
faq-answer-device-battery-low: No, that is not recommended. If the battery is completely drained, the connection may be lost.
faq-question-connection-issue: What should I do if my device is disconnected?
faq-answer-connection-issue: If the connection fails even after automatic reconnection attempts, turn the device off and on again.
faq-question-watch-companion: Does the Watch OS/Wear OS app work without the iOS/Android app?
faq-answer-watch-companion: No, the Watch OS/Wear OS app requires an active connection to the iOS/Android app to display data and device information.
faq-question-device-settings: When can I change my IQOS device settings?
faq-answer-device-settings: Device settings can only be changed when the device is connected and the Holder is inside the charging case (except for IQOS ILUMA ONE).
faq-question-background-task: What is the background process for?
faq-answer-background-task: The background process generates a daily summary of your sessions for the previous day.
faq-answer-multiple-session-recognition: For IQOS devices, this feature automatically adds all sessions once the Holder is recharged in the charging case.
faq-question-privacy: What data does the app collect?
faq-answer-privacy: The app only stores the information you enter. No personal data is sent to third parties or stored on servers.
faq-question-standalone: Does QYSH work without an IQOS device?
faq-answer-standalone: Yes. All core features – countdown, statistics, reduction plans, notifications, and widgets – work completely without a connected device: simply log your sessions with the '+' button. The Bluetooth connection to compatible IQOS devices is an optional extra.
faq-question-device-change: What happens to my data when I switch phones?
faq-answer-device-change: Your data is stored locally on your smartphone. If your device backup (e.g., iCloud or Google backup) or device-to-device transfer is enabled, your entries and settings are restored on the new phone. Without a backup, the data cannot be recovered.
faq-question-sync: Does the app sync between multiple devices?
faq-answer-sync: No. Your data stays local on one smartphone – there is no cloud synchronization between multiple smartphones. The Watch OS/Wear OS app mirrors the data of the connected smartphone.
